summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of Cactus Jack Brasil showcase. All 36 critical assertions across home, header nav, shop (catalog of 20, filter pills, search, sort), product cards add-to-cart with drawer + badge, product detail (gallery thumbs, size selector required + toast, qty inc/dec, buy now), unavailable/'Sob Consulta' fallback products, cart drawer (inc/dec/remove), localStorage persistence after reload, full checkout flow (personal + address fields, all 3 payment methods, CACTUS10 coupon discount line, place order -> /sucesso with CJB- order number, cart empties), Documentation & Sobre pages, and Footer Sick Code link (https://www.sickcode.com.br, target=_blank) PASSED. No console errors. No broken images on the Sobre page screenshot. Backend testing skipped per request (no backend in this app).
critical_code_review_comments: Footer's category links to /shop?cat=<name> work, but the Shop reads ?cat with URL-decoded values; values containing '&' like 'Moletons & Jaquetas' rely on react-router's auto-decoding — verified working but worth a manual eye check when adding new categories.
Checkout's 'place-order' submit handler does not validate that a payment method is selected if user clears 'pix' default — currently fine since a default is pre-set ('pix'). Low priority.
ProductCard 'Sob Consulta' link uses /produto/:id navigation; ProductDetail renders a disabled 'Consulte disponibilidade' button — flow is consistent and crash-free.
seed_data_creation: None — catalog seeded statically from /app/frontend/src/data/catalog.json (20 products).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows green. Notable testids verified: nav-{home,shop,sobre,documentation}, open-cart-button, cart-drawer, product-card-<id>, add-cart-<id>, product-link-<id>, consult-<id> (4 unavailable items present: 3 'Sob Consulta' + 1 sold-out 'camiseta-respect-vintage-oversized-travis-scott-black'), size-<S>, thumb-N, qty-inc/dec, add-to-cart-detail, buy-now, unavailable, cart-item-<id>, inc/dec/remove-<id>, checkout-button, field-*, pay-{pix,card,boleto}, coupon-input, apply-coupon, place-order, sickcode-link. Coupon CACTUS10 applied successfully; success page shows CJB-XXXXXX order id; cart cleared post-order.
